title: Live Screen Share Scanner
summary: Scan Genshin Impact directly from live screen and window streams on desktop and mobile browsers without saving or uploading video files.

changes.text: In-Browser Screen Sharing: Share your Genshin Impact window, full display, or mobile screen directly to scan materials, weapons, and artifacts live.
Seamless Video Scanner Flow: Starting screen share from any tab routes directly into the video scanner and records in place, preventing lost recordings upon tab switches.
Live Viewfinder HUD: Real-time recording indicator, duration timer, and one-tap Stop & Scan button with automatic video processing.
Mobile Screen Share Support: Enabled direct browser-based screen sharing for supported mobile devices without camera fallbacks.
